deploy-bot: ROLLBACK INITIATED for runtime-api in env=eu2
- rollback_id: rb-20240321-17
- initiated_by: sam
- target: service/runtime-api (subset: canary and primary)
- reason: sustained p95 latency spike + KV cache miss rate increase after r23.4.1
- action: pin previous tag r23.3.9, revert deploy, restart pods with graceful drain, keep other services intact
- commit_tag: r23.4.1 -> reverting to r23.3.9 (commit 7f8a9bc)
- expected_duration: ~15m (staged switchover)

sam: Acknowledged. Hold all follow-up releases into eu2 change window. Can we avoid touching DB migrations?

kevin: Confirmed no DB migrations in r23.4.1 for runtime-api, safe to revert code-only.

nisha: Running smoke tests in canary after pin. Please verify the smoke command: 
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://eu2.runtime-api.redwood.internal/health | jq .status
```
Will start smoke once deploy-bot flips traffic.

ops-bot: Observability alert: canary group latency still elevated (p95 640ms) — draining 25% traffic per policy.

sam: Thanks. Ops, keep an eye on downstream cache fill. If we see cache warm failures, throttle rollback and call it out here.

deploy-bot: STEP 1: pinned tag r23.3.9 to runtime-api in eu2 (pin persisted). STEP 2: scaled down canary replicas of r23.4.1 -> 0; scaled up r23.3.9 replicas. Rolling restart order: zone-a -> zone-b -> zone-c.

nisha: Started smoke tests on 25% traffic; results so far: 10/10 health checks pass, p95 trending down.

kevin: Noting release notes link for traceability: https://console.redwood.internal/releases/r23.4.1 (add followup notes about cache regression)

ops-bot: Canary drain progress: 25% -> 10% -> 0% (ETA 7m). No new errors in logs (monitoring quiet).

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETED for runtime-api in eu2 
- rollback_id: rb-20240321-17
- completed_by: deploy-bot (automated)
- duration: 8m 24s
- result: SUCCESS
- final_state: runtime-api -> tag r23.3.9 (pinned)
- reverted_commit: 7f8a9bc
- notes: canary fully drained, traffic back to previous routing policy

sam: :white_check_mark: Nice work. Please follow up with a short postmortem if we can't find root cause by EOD.

nisha: I'll capture smoke logs and a short checklist of steps I ran. Sharing artifacts: s3://redwood-ops/rollbacks/rb-20240321-17/smoke.log

kevin: I'll open an incident tracking stub and assign to infra/research for KV cache regression triage.

deploy-bot: Pin persisted in config-store and noted in audit logs. Hooked to rollback_id rb-20240321-17.

ops-bot: Closing alert stream for this rollback. If anything regresses re-open with `ops reopen rb-20240321-17`

sam: Closing loop here. Thanks everyone.
